cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We said the concert would bring the village together. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we'll sing together without microphones.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Half the audience has gone home for torches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Look at that. The village is already supplying its own light.

mechanism: A leads a village concert by making outages and audience errands fulfil the original hope of coming together, adjusting timing and roles to retain B cooperation.
confusable: A generic silver lining lacks repeated return to the same early communal hope through concrete adaptive choices.
comparison: Cottage alternative concerns shared ownership; this one turns audience participation into the performance itself.
seedUse: Concert seed supplies microphones and torches; S02 must respond to B practical participation concerns while keeping the original hope visible.
